---
title: "FAPROTADX2 DB conversion to FAPROTAX1"
author: "Lars Schreiber"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Rationale
With the update of FAPROTAX v1 to v2 the ability to add custom functions to the database was lost. So in order to leverage the more comprehensive v2 database but with the functionms mapper form v1, we will need to back convert the v2 DB to v1 format.

```{r loading necessary libraries}
library("tidyr")
library("readr")
library("stringr")
```

``` {r read data and convert format}
## Read 
faprotax2_db <- read_tsv(file = "faprotax2_db/FAPROTAX2-db_main.tsv")

## The database covers these functions
all_funcs <- colnames(faprotax2_db)[colnames(faprotax2_db) |> 
                                      str_detect(pattern = fixed(".value"))] |> 
  str_replace_all(pattern = fixed(".value"), replacement = "")

longest_name = 55

# Open custom function file so that we can add the v2 functions
custom_file <- "faprotax1_custom_func/FAPROTAX.custom.txt"
output_file <- "FAPROTAX2_cust.txt"

file.copy(from = custom_file, to = output_file)

my_connection <- file(output_file, open = "at", encoding = "UTF-8")

# Write empty lines between custom records and new records
writeLines("", con = my_connection)
writeLines("", con = my_connection)
writeLines("###############################################", con = my_connection)
writeLines("# All FAPROTAX2-imported functions", con = my_connection)
writeLines("###############################################", con = my_connection)
writeLines("", con = my_connection)
writeLines("", con = my_connection)

## Create FAPROTAX1 type of records in temporary files for each of the function
for (func in seq_along(all_funcs)){
  #func = 1
  function_column <- paste0(all_funcs[func], ".value")
  reference_column <- paste0(all_funcs[func], ".source")
  
  # Subset and filter the dataframe accordingly
  faprotax2_db_sub <- faprotax2_db[,c("species", function_column, reference_column)]
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub[faprotax2_db_sub[[function_column]] == "P",]
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[!is.na(faprotax2_db_sub_filt[[function_column]]),]
  
  # Remove all entries without a reference
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[!is.na(faprotax2_db_sub_filt[[reference_column]]),]
  
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- unique(faprotax2_db_sub_filt)
  
  # Replace all internal underscores with * in species names
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species <- str_replace_all(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species, pattern = fixed("_"), replacement = fixed("*"))
  # Add terminal *
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species <- paste0(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species,"*")
  
  # Sort by species name
  faprotax2_db_sub_filt <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[order(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species),]
  
  # Write function header to file
  writeLines(all_funcs[func], con = my_connection)
  writeLines("# - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - - -", con = my_connection)
  # Loop through the species for putting them into the file
  for (species in seq_along(faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species)){
    #species = 1
    # Pad species name with the right number of tabs
    current_species <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt$species[species]
    current_ref <- faprotax2_db_sub_filt[[reference_column]][species]
    # Convert reference to plaiun ASCII
    current_ref <- iconv(current_ref,
                         from = "",
                         to = "ASCII//TRANSLIT",
                         sub = "")
    
    output_line <- sprintf("%-*s # %s",
                           longest_name,
                           current_species,
                           current_ref)
    # Write output line
    writeLines(output_line, con = my_connection)
  }
  writeLines("", con = my_connection)
  writeLines("", con = my_connection)
}
close(my_connection)
```
